title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) A: Strong lens catalogue overview
summary: Euclid DR1 reports 15,072 grade A/B high-confidence lens candidates and 9,010 grade C candidates, including 84 candidate double-source-plane and over 1,000 candidate disc lenses. Model scores are followed by citizen-scientist inspection and expert grading. A/B are high-confidence candidates; C is lower-confidence. The paper reports candidates, not independent confirmation of each lens.
ai_technology: Five machine-learning models prioritize Euclid image cutouts for strong-lens review by about 7,000 citizen scientists and 67 experts.
organization: European Space Agency, European Space Astronomy Centre, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain
